title: Surreal Clock Landscape
description: A large circular clock face with Roman numerals contains a surreal desert scene in its lower half featuring golden sand dunes, a human skull, bats, spiders, and scattered orbs. The upper half shows a blue sky with the Eiffel Tower emerging from a large sphere, a globe, butterflies, birds, and various floating objects.
prompt: A surreal clock face with Roman numerals depicting a dreamlike scene, lower half shows golden sand dunes with a human skull, bats, spiders and orbs, upper half features the Eiffel Tower rising from a large sphere set against a blue sky, accompanied by a detailed globe, butterflies, birds and floating spheres in a whimsical Salvador Dali inspired composition.
